reconfigure.title: Change gateway address
reconfigure.description: The existing connection is briefly closed. The new endpoint must belong to the same panel.

user.title: Connect TELENOT serial gateway
user.description: Enter the TCP-serial gateway address. Pause other GMS clients first: this integration must own the serial handshake. Setup reads the panel identity and status; it does not arm or disarm the panel.

error.cannot_connect: Could not receive a complete GMS status. Check gateway address, port and whether another GMS client is running.

abort.already_configured: This gateway or panel is already configured.

init.title: TELENOT options
init.description: Writing is disabled by default. Enable only to allow explicit arming/disarming actions from Home Assistant, including your automations. The GMS interface has no user PIN authentication. No commands are sent just by enabling this option.

control_disabled.message: Arming and disarming are disabled in the integration options.

area_unavailable.message: The security area is unavailable or its configuration has not been confirmed.

command_rejected.message: The panel rejected the requested command. Check the panel status and logs.

command_uncertain.message: The command outcome is unknown. Check the panel before sending another command; it will not be repeated automatically.
